correctness.rationale: With m<F<2m the choice from m+1 through F-1 is arbitrary, and counting positive gaps gives g=F-1-r. All positive members below 2m are irreducible. At 2m+j with 1≤j≤N+1, a summand above F is impossible; reducibility is exactly the B+B test. At F+m+1 and above one subtracts m; 2m itself decomposes. For each j the potential representations have disjoint forbidden singleton coordinates and disjoint pairs, giving the stated coefficient, including N=0. A prescribed first-K pattern of a ones has probability (r)_a(N-r)_(K-a)/(N)_K, so the truncated law converges in TV. Coupling a fair-in-position iid sample of density θ=p/2 to the fixed-size sample by uniform addition or deletion fails to give containment only with probability exponentially small in N. On containment each of the floor((j-1)/2) disjoint pairs gives an independent chance θ² to cover j; the missed fringe has expectation at most a geometric tail in K plus (N+1) times the exponential failure bound. This yields both full TV and mean convergence, not merely weak convergence. Summing the iid odd/even terms gives (1-p)(2-p)/p². For the contextual unconditioned formulas, the missing j=N+1 singleton doubles the terminal Bernoulli hole probability; summing gives the stated finite mean, and tightness of Q_N gives Slutsky's Gaussian limit without a fixed-c hypothesis. My bounded replay checks 502 semigroups with 2≤m≤9, every c, coefficient sums by r and the exact fair-bit mean, but not the infinite limit, which follows from the argument. Replay: python3 /workspace/checks/1.py. The complete revised RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt are under /workspace/repairs/1/.

value.rationale: The surviving result gives a distribution-level description of the bounded-scale embedding-dimension variability after all three natural semigroup parameters are fixed. Conditioning removes the binomial bulk fluctuation and leaves a nondegenerate fringe throughout the interior density range. It is not a substitution of parameters in an iid limit: the local approximation alone cannot justify either total variation for a moving sumset fringe or the conditional means. The controlled tail makes the result useful for researchers comparing fixed-cardinality and iid ensembles.
